issue.title: Record Card: an editable value sheet under the H1 of every record note
issue.description: Every healthy record note shows its album-defined fields as a quiet, beautiful record sheet under the H1 and above ## Notes, in bob's vocabulary. Every value is editable from a keyboard-first Record Card (== , Ctrl+Shift+P, palette, Command Mode, or a click) through one guarded bob writer, with Undo. Native Properties hide only when the sheet shows every key and bob can write.

payload.entry:
Shipped the read-only record sheet in bob-ledger-tools 1.129.0 (plan:202611/record_sheet.md). Canonical desktop album records paint a sheet under the first H1 in Live Preview and Reading from metadataCache plus the cached album report. Hide class stays dormant. Subscription headers yield and dock. YAML `y` jumps without a Schema Card excursion.

Verified:
- 15 record-sheet unit tests pass, including midnight-rollover (no hanging timeout).
- 158 related tests pass (record-sheet + album-header/entrypoints/records + subscription surfaces + note-ready + period-strip/charts). The last three used to hang because setupRecordSheet scheduled a repeating 60s albumSetTimeout on every onload(); midnight now rides the existing window-gated plugin rollover.
- Isolated keep-moving / event-link-times / frees-marks budget tests pass (60/60).
- npm run validate and BOB_CLI_DIR docs:check pass.
- 375px light/dark fixture rendered with wkhtmltoimage (labels stack, missing pill, ghost chips, 8px radius).
- Deployed with `bob plugins sync --repo $PWD --no-pull -p bob-ledger-tools` to ~/bob (backup 20261117-134830).

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: keep-moving / event-link-times / frees-marks 25ms (and KT1 1000ms) budget tests flake under full `npm test` process-isolation load (elapsed 344–3436ms on this run) and pass in isolation (6.8–123ms). Load-sensitive, not a record-sheet regression.

New records/protocol.rs parses the envelope (duplicate-key/field, unknown key/version/op, wrong type, empty-string-set refusals); ops convert to planner inputs with literal list members (new SuppliedLiteralValues variant through schema/plan/render, so comma members round-trip). execute_update -i branch checks expect before planning; stale_record embeds the current record object for one-call repaint; success/no-op/dry-run/refusal share the typed JSON doc (changed, changes, fingerprints, inverse_ops, groups, consequence, album_index, warnings, error). bob albums list|check -f json now carries capabilities [record_values_v1]. Completion kinds entry added for the new flag. No epic-symbol leftovers.
